title: OutputHistoryPayloadResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/history/:point/rows (HEL-1276): the stored full row payload of one history point. Authenticated only (never public); readable by the Output's owner and pipeline grantees. An unknown or inaccessible Output, a point of another Output and a point with no stored payload all return 404. `capturedAt`, `runId` and `triggerSource` are the history point's; `rowCount` and `rows` the payload's (rows in their original order, at most the configured row cap). Every nullable field is present as an explicit null.
